title: Mr. Radicali Or De Brandza

page_data.en:

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. _________
Date _______________

Date October 20, 1938.

(Special Branch) Office Notes

D.C. (Special Branch),

Information has been obtained from a very reliable source that a Mr. Radicali or de Brandza, Italian subject, living at Room 403 of the China United Apartments, Bubbling Well Road, is at present engaged in the supplying of aeroplanes to the Japanese Authorities. The parts are shipped to Dairen where they are assembled and not to Japan. He represents the firm of Breda. The firms Breda, Caproni and Fiat are, it is believed, about to amalgamate in the Far East, and Mr. Radicali may be appointed as representative in Tokyo.

It is further learned that a Mrs. Crompton, British by marriage, Italian by birth, her maiden name being Azaretti, is a very important personage in this business. She is secretary-mistress to Mr. Cavilli, Far East representative for the Fiat Company. Both returned recently from Tokyo.

日期：1938年10月20日。

（特别科）办公笔记

致特别科副总监，

从一非常可靠的消息来源获悉，一名名为 Radicali 先生或 de Brandza 先生的意大利籍人士，现居住于静安寺路中国联合公寓403室，目前正从事向日本当局供应飞机之业务。零部件被运往大连进行组装，而非运往日本。他代表布雷达（Breda）公司。据信，布雷达、卡普罗尼（Caproni）和菲亚特（Fiat）等公司即将在远东合并，Radicali 先生可能被任命为驻东京代表。

另悉，一位 Crompton 夫人，因婚姻关系为英国籍，出生时为意大利籍，婚前姓名为 Azaretti，在此业务中是一位非常重要的人物。她是菲亚特公司远东代表 Cavilli 先生的秘书兼情妇。两人最近均从东京返回。
